Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Platform teams Source: ../books/b01-transformation-arc/03-platform-foundation.md

Task.Name: P0.4 Read-only assessment run and committed

Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Platform teams Source: ../books/b01-transformation-arc/12-migration-roadmap.md#phase-4-legacy-retirement-weeks-3744
